pending_user_directives: Use independent professional judgment; do not ask for confirmation on routine architecture/development decisions when the direction can be determined from mission and evidence.

Historical occurrence/target time should match the precision that matters and the source can support: month/quarter/stage/range is often more truthful than an exact day. Never manufacture exact dates for convenience; known-time/no-lookahead eligibility still uses a conservative information-availability bound.

A high-value model memory that cannot be directly recovered from the old/open internet or a closed source may be retained as an auditable research-only indirectly corroborated hypothesis when bounded direct-source search plus independent archived indirect evidence and mechanism/sequence reasoning support it. Preserve alternatives, falsification conditions and search receipts; never silently promote model memory or logic into Fact/Judgment/Reality.

For listed-company announcements, major finance portals such as Sina Finance, Tencent Finance, Tonghuashun, Xueqiu and Eastmoney are approved authoritative redistributors when they provide the formal announcement/original document; preserve actual retrieval host and upstream announcement identity, and do not treat summaries/editorial rewrites as equivalent formal-announcement evidence.

Programmatic trading/financial-data APIs and open-source quant/data/announcement projects are approved acquisition/redistribution lanes for formal listed-company announcements when the actual payload and upstream identity are verifiable. Open-source code alone is not Evidence, and platform-derived metrics, standardized fields, classifications or forecasts require separate claim-scoped authority assessment.
Multiple redistributors carrying the same upstream filing or announcement remain one evidence cluster and must not be counted as independent corroboration.
Every substantive work session must update the repository handoff before returning control, so the next Agent never depends on chat memory.
